prompts.prompt:
Create a production animation sprite atlas for a photoreal desktop fashion character. Use the supplied reference image only as a visual identity and clothing reference: the same clearly adult East Asian woman, loose brown ponytail, wispy bangs, gentle natural face, sage green windbreaker over ivory tee, wide white trousers, sage and cream sneakers. Preserve the clothing and person's realistic photographic character, natural body proportions and real fabric texture. No phone, no handbag, hands relaxed at her sides.
OUTPUT: ONE square PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, absolutely no white background, checkerboard, words, numbers, borders, map pin, UI or scenery.
EXACT ATLAS LAYOUT: 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, eight separate full-body photos of this exact same woman doing a stationary clockwise turntable. Equal-sized cells each 25% image width and 50% image height. Each person's central body axis exactly at the center of its cell; soles at 95% of cell height, top of head at 5% of cell height. Keep identical camera distance, body height, lighting and neutral relaxed pose in all eight frames, include entire head and both shoes.
READING ORDER LEFT TO RIGHT THEN NEXT ROW: 0 degrees front facing camera; 45 degrees three-quarter view with nose toward image right; 90 degrees right-facing profile; 135 degrees three-quarter back; 180 degrees straight back; 225 degrees three-quarter back with nose toward image left; 270 degrees left-facing profile; 315 degrees three-quarter front with nose toward image left.
This is a realistic studio fashion photography contact sheet for frame-by-frame animation, NOT a collage of different poses. Soft bright neutral studio illumination, crisp individual hair strands and clothing seams. Nothing overlaps neighboring cells. Background fully transparent.
